This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

From Sweden’s turretless Strv 103 and Chrysler’s bizarre nuclear-powered tank concept to Italy’s gigantic Fiat 2000 and New Zealand’s infamous Bob Semple tank, history is full of strange armored vehicles. Discover the unusual engineering, ambitious ideas, and questionable decisions behind some of the weirdest tanks ever designed!
